scope: Read-only audit of four frozen upstream checkouts before dependency installation or public-benchmark execution.

findings: The repository declares minimum versions in README but ships no requirements lockfile.
Backbone, API base, API key, and encoder paths are empty source placeholders.
The default output directory is result_debug rather than the documented result directory.
Per-dataset exceptions are caught and the outer loop continues, so process exit zero is insufficient evidence of completeness.
A-Mem and MemoryOS are not executable through the main harness without adapting their official examples.
required_external_guards: expected versus observed dataset and QA denominators
resolved model and evaluator configuration snapshot

findings: The token-free retrieve-only switch is implemented for LoCoMo, not for the final Mem-Gallery entrypoint.
The Mem-Gallery final runner requires an OpenAI-compatible LLM and catches per-question exceptions as empty answers.
MAX limits total questions and DATASETS limits named datasets; both can support a frozen smoke subset.
The metric-only scorer can disable the LLM judge and reuse the Mem-Gallery evaluator.
required_external_guards: fixed DATASETS list and MAX value

findings: The official framework exposes 11 memory baselines plus harness and answer-only baselines.
The small split contains 150 samples and --sample-index supports one-sample execution.
The --dry-run branch prints resolved path-level configuration and returns before dataset existence, adapter construction, or API validation.
Requirements specify lower bounds rather than an exact lock.
The official dry-run executes at most five examples with deterministic local fallbacks and can avoid API calls.
The repository ships pytest tests and a 87-example validated Causal-LoCoMo-with-history artifact.
The released 87-example run contains 609 predictions and 0 recorded failures, corresponding to seven methods over all examples.
The released run config records git_commit as the literal HEAD rather than an immutable hash.
The released run uses a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint while reporting zero cost; its cost_usd field is therefore not comparison-eligible.
required_external_guards: fresh environment and full pytest pass
dataset validation and 87 by 7 denominator check
exclude released cost_usd from cost claims

decision: Proceed to isolated dependency environments and official non-final smoke runs. No baseline is accepted for same-protocol comparison by this static audit alone.
